title: Legacy program money routed through FFRDCs and bales of cash
place_text: DoD labs, MRTFBs, Crystal City, Arlington

tellings.quote: And I really think the amount of money that's moved can't really be tracked because I myself have talked to witnesses who have seen cash moved like physical bales of cash taken to locations.

plain: Money for so-called legacy programmes, secret projects said to study unexplained craft, moves in ways that cannot be tracked, including physical bales of cash carried to locations, says a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb. He says he has spoken to witnesses who saw this, and ties it to government-funded research centres, military test ranges and offices in Crystal City and Arlington. If true, such programmes could be paid for outside normal oversight.
